standard-dialogue-with-ghostspeak-amulet.text: If the player has not completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: Meh, I don't want to talk about it.

standard-dialogue-with-ghostspeak-amulet.text: If the player has completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: Not too well. I miss my friend. She couldn't join us here today.
She had some afterlife business to take care of. Nieve's always so busy.

steps.player: Nieve? I used to know a Nieve, but she died during horrible circumstances.

steps.npc: Really? You must be [player name]! She talks about you a lot.

steps.player: Does she? I miss her. Steve is alright, but... he's not Nieve.
Anyway, please send her my regards and let her know that I avenged her death.
